case_title: JEAN CLAUDE LAIR VS. MATTHEW BANCROFT ET AL

docket_entries.description: ORDER CASE CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS TO DEFENDANT ANN BANCROFT PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-05-2021 - JUDGMENT. CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS TO ANN BANCROFT BY COURT AT SMALL CLAIM HEARING OF MAR-05-2021 AT 3:30 PM. PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT AND ORDER OF FEBRUARY 19, 2021. JUDGMENT AS TO DEFENDANT MATTHEW BANCROFT IS ISSUED PURSUANT TO FEBRUARY 19, 2021 ORDER. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANTS. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LAIR, JEAN CLAUDE DBA  CABLE CAR HOTEL RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT BANCROFT, MATTHEW $7,950.00 PRINCIPAL, $95.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $8,045.00, JUDGMENT AS TO DEFENDANT MATTHEW BANCROFT IS ISSUED PURSUANT TO FEBRUARY 19, 2021 ORDER. DEFENDANT ANN BANCROFT IS DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT OF FEBRUARY 19, 2021. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED

MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $9,600.00 FILED BY LAIR, JEAN CLAUDE DBA  CABLE CAR HOTEL AS TO DEFENDANT BANCROFT, MATTHEW BANCROFT, ANN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-19-2021 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED DEC-03-2020, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT BANCROFT, ANN
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$20.00) SERVED OCT-23-2020, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT BANCROFT, MATTHEW

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-19-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO MAR-05-2021 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF JEAN CLAUDE LAIR IS PRESENT WITH WITNESS KRISS MIRANDA, PROPERTY MANAGER. DEFENDANT MATTHEW BANCROFT IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT ANN BANCROFT IS PRESENT WITH WITNESS IRWIN KARP, HUSBAND. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $1675 FROM DEFENDANT ANN BANCROFT TO THE PLAINTIFF. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE MAR-05-2021 HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE AGAINST DEFENDANT ANN BANCROFT WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
